about.t: builds secure systems for DoD / intelligence-community targeting

hours — dynamic citation management, classification roll-up,
fine-grained access control. spring boot apis + angular.

primary engineer; sustained delivery across 14 sprints.
▸ shipped 8 containerized services into 4 classified and
unclassified environments with devsecops ci/cd practices.

▸ wrote the docs, presented the prototype, aligned stakeholders.
▸ automated an internal onboarding tool that replaced email workflows.
